pack_name: Beautiful HTML Templates - Bold Design Pack

usage.selection: Read this compact index first to shortlist bold templates from metadata. Avoid shortlisting two templates from the same aesthetic quadrant.
usage.paths: Each template lives at templates/<slug>/ inside this pack: preview.md (title-slide preview) and design.md (full design system). Derive paths from slug.
usage.previews: For title-slide previews, read only templates/<slug>/preview.md for the shortlisted bold candidates.
usage.final_generation: After the user chooses a bold template, read exactly that templates/<slug>/design.md before generating the full deck.
usage.never: Do not bulk-read templates/*/design.md. template.html handling: see references/workflow.md Phase 2 (Preview file protocol).

deck_forge_policy.mobile_behavior: preserve 16:9 stage; letterbox or pillarbox instead of reflowing slide content

templates.name: 8-Bit Orbit
templates.tagline: Pixel-art neon arcade aesthetic on a deep navy void.
templates.differs_from: Only pixel-art CRT arcade look; louder than studio.
templates.best_for: Cyberpunk, gaming, web3, indie dev tools, hackathon demos, synthwave brand decks, nostalgic-digital tech talks.
templates.avoid_for: Quiet institutional finance, patient-facing healthcare, traditional luxury.

templates.name: Biennale Yellow
templates.tagline: Solar yellow on warm parchment with deep indigo serif and atmospheric sun-glow gradients.
templates.differs_from: Sun-glow yellow on parchment; brighter than soft-editorial's pastel calm.
templates.best_for: Exhibition decks, arts-institution announcements, design-conference brochures, curatorial pitches, literary publications, studio retrospectives.
templates.avoid_for: Decks needing visual punch or saturated multi-color energy.

templates.name: BlockFrame
